Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http://www.dilg.com.ph 07 zoa CILG OPINION NO. a. MR. JEFFERSON D. VALDEZ Property Manager Oceanway Residences Condominium Corporation Boracay Newcoast, Brgy. Yapak, Malay, Aklan Dear Mr. Valdez: This has reference to your letter dated 16 August 2019, seeking the Department's legal opinion concerning the unit rentals in Oceanway Residences Condominium. Per your letter, the property and its Condominium Corporation were duly registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Ostensibly, however, the local government of Malay had ordered to temporarily stop all rental businesses conducted in Oceanway Residences Condominium after the Boracay was ordered to close in April 2018. Hence, the query as to why the foregoing is being restricted. In reply thereto, please be apprised that Boracay Inter-Agency Task Force (BIATF) was created pursuant to Executive Order No. 53, series of 20181, of which vice-chaired by this Department. Said EO, mandates the BIATF, inter alia: "Section 2 Powers and Functions. The Task Force shall have the following powers and functions: Xxx (c) Coordinate with concerned agencies and LGUs on the immediate withholding or revocation of permits or licenses issued to any establishment or business the operation, facility or structure of which violates environmental laws and local ordinances, such as but not limited to, construction of resorts and tourism facilities along easement areas and forest lands illegal reclamation and/or occupation of wetlands, lack of permits to operate or discharge waste water, and operation without or in violation Environmental Compliance Certificate and Environmental Sanitation Clearance; 1 Executive Order No. 53, series of 2018, entitled: Creating a Boracay Inter-Agency Task Force, Providing for its Powers and Functions and those of the Member-Agencies thereof, and other Measures to Reverse the Degradation of Boracay Island.

(d) Ensure that the concerned agency of LGUs undertake the appropriate measures relative to the violation of environmental laws, including demolition, closure or cessation of business and/or filling of administrative action against erring persons or establishments. Xxx " On 18 June 2018, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has subsequently issued Memorandum Circular No. 2018-08, series of 20182, ordering the suspension of all environmental compliance certificates (ECC) issued in Boracay Island, Malay, Aklan to thoroughly review and re-evaluate the same in terms of their compliance with the local and national laws, rules and regulations. Relative thereto, a committee composed of representatives form DENR, Environmental Management Bureau (EMB) and Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB) was created to review establishments' compliance with all existing ECCs and environmental management plans, and to present report to the Secretary of DENR for either the lifting of the suspension or cancellation of the same. Corollarily, the BIATF had implemented a "No Compliance, no Opening" policy to ensure that establishments follow rules and regulations and ultimately ensure that the establishments therein would not bring unacceptable impact to environment. Thus, for as long as the suspension of all existing ECCs is not yet lifted by the DENR, the "No Compliance, No Opening" policy may still be implemented, albeit the reopening of the Boracay Island. We hope the foregoing be sufficient to enlighten you on the matters presented herein. Very truly yours, By the authority of the S cretary MARIVE C. SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 Unde ecretary for Local Governme Legal/27 2 DENR MC NO. 2018-08, entitled: "Suspension Of all Environmental Compliance Certificates (ECCs) in the Island Of Boracay, Malay, Aklan
